task.description: Run the full integration test suite (not just test-integration-iss103) to confirm re-enabling audit triggers on tenant_default.process_definitions, instance_projections, tasks, dead_letter_items, webhook_subscriptions, and webhook_deliveries does not regress any other currently-passing test.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test-integration passes in full
tests/reports/report written per test guide format

result.summary: zig build test-integration-iss103 passes 4/4 both in isolation and inside the full aggregate test-integration run (no failures for this file either way). The full aggregate suite (zig build test-integration, ~52 sub-steps / 669 tests) itself fails (536 pass, 9 skip, 124 fail; 134 distinct failing test cases), but every failing case was categorized and traced to one of two pre-existing, already-filed, unrelated root causes: (b) ISS-0094/ISS-0095 pattern - tenant context not set before Pool.init(), search_path defaults to public, relation-does-not-exist / TenantNotFound (41 cases, across 21 files, a superset of the 4 files BACKEND-DEV originally flagged for ISS-0095); (c) aggregate-run Postgres deadlocks and unique/FK constraint races caused by 30+ test binaries running concurrently against one shared bpm_test container when the aggregate step runs them all at once, a previously-documented class of infra noise (see docs/issues/ISS-0090.json) reproduced here (93 cases across 26 files). Zero cases (0) fell into a new/unexplained category (c-new-regression). The ISS-0093 diff is confirmed scoped to tests/integration/helpers.zig (shim removal) and tests/integration/audit_iss103_test.zig (its own cleanup helper) only - it touches no connection pooling, migration dispatch, or module implicated in any failing file. Full categorized breakdown written to tests/reports/report-2026-07-31-WF03-iss0093-20260731.yaml.

issues.description: ISS-0094 (GitHub #348, already filed by BACKEND-DEV) not re-diagnosed here. Did not manifest in this run because the DB-level patch to tenant_default.audit_entries.resource_id from Step 03 is still holding for this session. If the test DB is reprovisioned/recreated, ISS-103-INT tests may fail again for this reason, not because the ISS-0093 fix regressed.

ISS-0095 (GitHub #349, already filed by BACKEND-DEV for 4 files) is confirmed by this full-suite run to additionally affect at least 17 more integration test files (21 total) sharing the same missing-tenant-context-before-Pool.init() root cause. Recommend updating ISS-0095 affected-files list. Full list in tests/reports/report-2026-07-31-WF03-iss0093-20260731.yaml under failures_categorized.category_b_iss0095_pattern.affected_files.

Running zig build test-integration as one aggregate step causes 30+ independent test binaries to execute concurrently against a single shared bpm_test Postgres container, producing deadlocks and unique/FK constraint races not present when files run individually via their dedicated zig build test-integration-<name> targets. Consistent with prior finding in docs/issues/ISS-0090.json (long-lived shared bpm_test container issues). Not filed as a new issue since it matches an already-documented pattern; flagged for visibility as it accounted for 93 of 134 failing cases in this run.
